_readme: Illustrative data for /pro/sample-report/ and the downloadable sample PDF. This is ONE dataset on purpose: the HTML page, the PDF and tools/check_sample_coverage.py all read it, so they cannot disagree. The nine `key` values are not free text — they are the check keys the engine runs, and the gate fails if this file and shared/scan-engine.js ever differ. No score, no counts, no dates and no history length live here: they are all derived from `checks` and `history`.
disclaimer: Illustrative data. Not generated from a customer scan.

checks.title: Google Consent Mode v2
checks.detail: Consent Mode v2 default state found (ad_storage and analytics_storage).

checks.title: IAB TCF
checks.detail: One TCF signal found: __tcfapi. No IAB consent string is stored, so ad-tech partners cannot read the visitor's consent.
checks.fix: Store an IAB consent string through your CMP and expose it on __tcfapi. See https://iabeurope.eu/tcf/.

checks.title: Third-party trackers
checks.detail: Trackers found in the served markup: Google Analytics, Meta Pixel. No consent platform is loaded before them, so they fire before consent.
checks.fix: Block non-essential tags until the visitor consents (GDPR Art. 6 and ePrivacy require consent BEFORE the tracker loads, not a banner afterwards).

checks.title: HTTPS & HSTS
checks.detail: TLS 1.3 active, valid certificate (Let's Encrypt), HSTS max-age=31536000.

checks.title: Cookie consent
checks.detail: Consent banner detected and cookie categories are declared (GDPR Art. 13).

checks.title: Forms & privacy link
checks.detail: 5 forms detected, privacy policy linked in the footer.

checks.title: Legal pages
checks.detail: Privacy policy and terms of service found on common paths.

checks.title: Security headers
checks.detail: No Content-Security-Policy and no X-Frame-Options. NIS2 Art. 21 expects basic technical measures, and CSP is the one auditors ask for first.
checks.fix: Add Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'. Start in report-only mode and tighten from the violations it reports.

checks.title: DORA page-signal markers
checks.detail: Page-text markers found: Incident response / SOC reporting, Status page / uptime monitoring, SPF (email sender auth). This is not a DORA assessment.

_history_readme: One illustrative score per day, oldest first; the last value is the current score. The number of days shown, the dates, the bar heights and the dip annotation are all derived from this list — a hand-written "30 days of history" is exactly the kind of constant that stops matching the report above it.
